supersedes_open_item: m5-v3-reprovision-receipt.json listed world_test as NOT DONE; this receipt closes it.
what_this_proves: A VM re-provisioned from baseline reproduces the behaviour that was world-tested in the pre-cutover v2 cut. All five P7 services ran from digest pins resolved out of a validated release bundle at baseline commit 807769a, the deployment source was a baseline checkout rather than the retired comfy repo, and the pins survived a systemd restart before this session began.

route.exercised: Spawn, teleport-route portals, dense construction (castle, most of it loaded), forced portal-out, then stationary in woods while the queue drained.
route.notes: The window auto-resets whenever the server empties ('ZDO primary delivery window reset while server is empty'), so this sample is from a single unbroken session and cannot be reconstructed from later totals.

known_open_issues: The mod logs 'Lumberjacks telemetry heartbeat failed: HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict' roughly every 25s while heartbeats simultaneously succeed (heartbeat_stale stayed false and coverage kept climbing). The gateway logged no warnings or errors across the same period. Unexplained; leading hypothesis is an instance-registration conflict left by the systemd restart. Did not affect any acceptance criterion.

Strict roster remains DISARMED. It is in-memory only and the systemd restart disarmed it; it was deliberately left off so it could not block the join. This acceptance run therefore does not exercise strict-roster admission.
Two-consumer isolation remains UNTESTED, as in the v2 cut. This run had a single consumer.
